items.text: Lamar Jackson (ankle) OUT; Tyler Huntley starts vs Falcons. Downgrade for Ravens pass catchers but still playable in some spots per context.
items.why: Ankle sprain from Week 4; official OUT.
items.implication: Huntley limits upside of Flowers/Andrews/Likely; Berry still has Likely as LOVE TE5.
items.opportunity: Reduced efficiency/volume risk for Ravens skill; Likely red-zone still viable

items.text: Ashton Jeanty (foot/ankle) QUESTIONABLE; Raiders elevated RB Roman Hemby. Outlook uncertain; Mike Washington Jr. also standing by.
items.why: Downgraded after full Wed; foot added to ankle; DNP Fri; travels and 'best to go'.
items.implication: Game-time; if OUT, Washington/Hemby committee; start if active as RB1/2.
items.opportunity: Monitor inactive window; handcuff elevation signals risk

items.text: Ja'Marr Chase (concussion) and Tee Higgins (groin/neck) both QUESTIONABLE for CIN @ MIA; outlook uncertain. No PS WRs elevated. If out, Gesicki/Meyers upside.
items.why: Protocol/practice limited; final designations pending Sunday AM.
items.implication: Monitor 90-min window; start if active, pivot to Meyers/Gesicki if OUT.
items.opportunity: If OUT, TE/WR2+ targets spike for backups

items.text: Cardinals finalizing trade of WR Marvin Harrison Jr.; informed him Saturday he will be inactive vs Detroit as details finalized. Trade expected after Sunday games; Houston among teams in mix.
items.why: Trade talks finalized enough for AZ to sit him; first-round value sought.
items.implication: Zero fantasy production Week 5; long-term landing spot TBD (HOU/Stroud reunion possible).
items.opportunity: Immediate target/role expansion for AZ remaining WRs

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley (hamstring) ruled OUT vs Jaguars in London. Will Shipley primary back; Dameon Pierce elevated for depth. DeVonta Smith also OUT.
items.implication: Shipley lead back in London; Goedert elevated as top target for Hurts.
items.opportunity: RB snaps/carries/goal-line to Shipley; TE/WR targets up without Smith

items.text: Vikings elevating Odell Beckham Jr. from PS; Justin Jefferson (ankle) and Jordan Addison (hamstring) both QUESTIONABLE optimistic vs NO. Insurance with top WRs Q.
items.implication: Likely play but monitor; Berry hates Addison.
items.opportunity: If limited, OBJ or other snaps

items.text: Commanders: Stefon Diggs (hamstring) OUT; Terry McLaurin (hamstring) QUESTIONABLE optimistic; Van Jefferson elevated. Jayden Daniels expected IN/starting (elbow). McNichols OUT.
items.why: Hamstring for Diggs; Daniels full practice/return confirmed.
items.implication: Daniels back boosts WAS offense; McLaurin likely plays; Jefferson depth.
items.opportunity: WR targets redistribute; Daniels dual-threat return

items.text: Cruelest thing for MHJ drafters is him inactive vs Lions secondary this week.
Steelers placed WR Michael Pittman Jr. on IR (foot); misses minimum 4 games.
items.implication: Longer absence; Steelers WR depth thins further.

items.text: Key INs from final board: Jayden Daniels, Chris Olave, Jeremiyah Love, Dallas Goedert expected/active. Love workload upgrade noted historically despite ankle.
items.why: Full/limited cleared; Daniels coach confirm start.
items.implication: Start with confidence; Love clear of Allgeier role bump per prior Levitan.

items.text: Chargers: Quentin Johnston (chest) OUT; Ladd McConkey (foot) QUESTIONABLE optimistic. Trey Lance to IR.
items.implication: McConkey if active primary; else other LAC WRs.

items.text: MHJ had only 5 catches in 4 games and was not a real factor; inactive opens Kia Kendrick Bourne / Michael Wilson season in AZ.
items.why: MHJ low impact volume; post-trade/inactive vacuum.
items.implication: Wilson elevated for volume/red-zone in DET matchup; Bourne szn too.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets previously contested now freer for Wilson

items.text: Jets RB Breece Hall (quad) OUT; Tim Patrick activated from IR with no designation.
items.implication: Jets backfield to backups; Patrick available for WR depth.

items.text: Loves Michael Wilson vs DET as WR10; volume/red-zone especially post-MHJ inactive.
items.why: Target volume + DET secondary + MHJ vacuum.

items.text: Loves Chase Brown @ MIA as RB5; gobbles targets/points, usage/matchup, nickname Brown Gobbler. Bengals WR injuries boost.
items.why: High usage + soft MIA run D + potential WR outs (Chase/Higgins Q).

items.text: Loves Nico Collins @ TEN as WR8; volume including red-zone vs weak Titans pass D.
Loves Isaiah Likely @ WSH as TE5 and Christian Watson vs CHI as WR15; coverage/positional weaknesses.
items.why: Matchup gifts despite Lamar OUT for Likely.

items.text: Hates Jordan Addison @ NO (WR41), Mark Andrews @ ATL (TE17), Cam Skattebo @ WSH (RB20), Tony Pollard vs HOU (RB28), Jalen Hurts vs JAX London (QB15). Tough matchups, thin roles, efficiency/game script issues; Hurts banged-up line.
items.why: Matchup/usage/efficiency red flags; Addison injury wrinkle.
items.conflict: Likely LOVE despite Lamar OUT contrasts Andrews HATE
